title: FY 2024-25 LTCG Rs 1 lakh at 10 % (pre-23-Jul) + Rs 1 lakh at 12.5 % (post): Rs 1.25 lakh threshold applied to the 12.5 % part first
covers: s.112A threshold allocation between 10 % and 12.5 % parts
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: tax on LTCG 'exceeding one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees' at 10 % (transfer before 23-Jul-2024) and 12.5 % (on/after); the Act does not say which part the Rs 1,25,000 is set against

No statutory ordering rule and no CBDT circular on this point was located in this session; the expected value adopts the order most beneficial to the assessee (general interpretive principle that, where a provision admits two readings, the one favourable to the assessee is preferred - CIT v. Vegetable Products Ltd (1973) 88 ITR 192 (SC))
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance (No.2) Act 2024 s.2)
derivation: Beneficial order (chosen): threshold first against the 12.5 % part: 1,00,000 fully covered; remaining 25,000 against the 10 % part -> 75,000 at 10 % = 7,500.00.
